name: Hybrid Differentiable Rendering Method
aliases: Analysis-by-synthesis inverse rendering with SfM/MVS/Poisson initialization
definition: An analysis-by-synthesis inverse rendering technique that reconstructs 3D geometry and physically-based reflectance (PBR) materials from multi-view 2D images captured by conventional hand-held cameras under uncontrolled lighting.
summary: The Hybrid Differentiable Rendering Method reconstructs 3D geometry and physically-based materials from multi-view images by combining efficient approximate rendering for geometry with high-fidelity physically-based rendering for reflectance.
